establishment--noun.def: The act of founding something, or an organization.
establishment--noun.ex: The establishment of the school took years.

environmental--adj.def: Relating to the natural world and its protection.

fax--noun.def: A copy of a document sent down a phone line.

fax--verb.def: To send a document by fax machine.
fax--verb.ex: Fax the form to the office.

partial--adj.def: Not complete, only part of something.

terrorism--noun.def: The use of violence for political aims.

vegetarian--adj.def: Containing no meat, or eating no meat.

vegetarian--noun.def: A person who does not eat meat.

surprisingly--adv.def: In a way that you did not expect.

conservative--adj.def: Preferring traditional ways, or careful and moderate.

slavery--noun.def: The system of owning people as property.
slavery--noun.ex: Slavery was abolished here long ago.

rebuild--verb.def: To build something again after damage.
rebuild--verb.ex: They rebuilt the bridge in a year.
rebuild--verb.exTr: Köprüyü bir yılda yeniden inşa ettiler.

trumpet--noun.def: A brass instrument played by blowing.
trumpet--noun.ex: He plays trumpet in a band.

comedian--noun.def: A performer whose job is making people laugh.

babysitter--noun.def: A person who looks after children for a short time.

delete--verb.def: To remove something written or stored.

estimate--verb.def: To judge an amount without measuring it exactly.
estimate--verb.ex: They estimate the cost at ten thousand.
estimate--verb.exTr: Maliyeti on bin olarak tahmin ediyorlar.

marble--noun.def: A hard stone used for floors and statues.

curly--adj.def: Having curves or curls, especially hair.

flock--noun.def: A group of birds or sheep.
flock--noun.ex: A flock of birds crossed the sky.

glimpse--noun.def: A very quick look at something.
glimpse--noun.ex: I caught a glimpse of her.

kettle--noun.def: A container used for boiling water.

currency--noun.def: The money used in a particular country.

souvenir--noun.def: Something you buy to remember a place.

dislike--verb.def: To not like someone or something.

achievement--noun.def: Something important that you succeed in doing.
achievement--noun.ex: The bridge was a great achievement.

newly--adv.def: Recently, only a short time ago.

creator--noun.def: The person who made or invented something.
creator--noun.ex: The creator of the game is young.

distribution--noun.def: The act of giving or sending things to many places.

apparent--adj.def: Easy to see, or seeming true without being certain.

preparation--noun.def: The work you do to get ready.

flute--noun.def: A long thin instrument you play by blowing across it.

kitten--noun.ex: The kitten slept in a box.

contribution--noun.def: Something you give to help a shared effort.

devotion--noun.def: Great love and loyalty towards someone.
devotion--noun.ex: His devotion to his students was clear.

blog--noun.def: A personal website with regular written entries.

glance--noun.ex: He gave the paper a glance.

glance--verb.def: To look at something very quickly.

server--noun.def: A computer that stores data for other computers.
server--noun.ex: The server went down at noon.

appreciation--noun.def: The feeling of being grateful or of valuing something.
appreciation--noun.ex: He showed his appreciation with flowers.

historic--adj.def: Important enough to be remembered in history.

promote--verb.def: To give someone a better job, or to advertise something.

introduction--noun.def: The first part of a book, or the act of presenting someone.

breeding--noun.def: The keeping of animals to produce young.

part-time--adj.def: Working fewer hours than a full job.

part-time--adv.def: For only part of the working week.
part-time--adv.ex: He works part-time at a café.

scholar--noun.def: A person who studies a subject deeply.
scholar--noun.ex: The scholar read the old texts.

embarrassment--noun.def: The uncomfortable feeling of being embarrassed.

handkerchief--noun.def: A small square of cloth for your nose.

brotherhood--noun.def: A feeling of friendship between people.

academic--adj.def: Relating to study at a school or university.
academic--adj.ex: The academic year starts in September.

publicly--adv.def: In a way that everyone can see or hear.

unpredictable--adj.def: Changing in a way you cannot expect.

category--noun.def: A group of things that are similar.

cautious--adj.def: Careful to avoid danger or mistakes.

comparison--noun.def: The act of looking at differences between things.

freshman--noun.def: A student in the first year of high school or college.
freshman--noun.ex: She is a freshman this year.

haunt--noun.def: A place someone visits very often.
haunt--noun.ex: That café is his old haunt.
haunt--noun.exTr: O kafe onun eski uğrak yeri.

improvement--noun.def: A change that makes something better.

bakery--noun.def: A shop where bread and cakes are made and sold.

admission--noun.def: Permission to enter, or the act of admitting something.

tropical--adj.def: From the hot wet regions near the equator.

pharmacy--noun.def: A shop where medicines are sold.

full-time--adj.def: Working the whole normal number of hours.

breakthrough--noun.def: An important discovery that solves a problem.
breakthrough--noun.ex: The drug was a real breakthrough.

relaxing--adj.def: Making you feel calm and rested.
